title: Asked AI to improve my capsule art, should I use it?
author: eRickoCS

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: I wish! Original looks very idle. I gotta add some knees and elbows to get the fighting poses right.

comments.author: Initial_Plastic_8069
comments.body: your original models lookd better, the bototm one got better text I believeand some small details like that sword looks better on bottom right

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: Text can always be improved, original has sprites directly from the game. But the bad thing is they’re just standing still. I’m going to add some action so it better indicates that that “you’re fighting eachother”.

comments.author: RatbyteGames
comments.body: I prefer the top one myself.

comments.author: waxenpi
comments.body: No idea which is yours but the text and characters should be muuuuuuuuch bigger. Also the logo could be improved. Hard to read mostly due to dark purple sword.

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: Oh damn I thought it’s pretty obvious that the top one has AI characteristics. Totally agree about the title color. But for size I heard it’s recommended to be like around 30% of the whole image? I felt like I made it too big hah.

replies.author: NoType9715
replies.body: They both have AI characteristics. How did you make the bottom one?

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: Background is AI generated by using sketch layout as a reference. Characters & pets are handmade (chicken & duck from itch) and chopped out from in-game (used green background and removed it). Title is handmade too.

replies.author: NoType9715
replies.body:
What do you mean sketch layout as a reference? Just curious

I asked because in the bottom one, the frog and cat characters look drawn with a stylus freehand using pixel brush/settings, or a mouse. they don't look like the "proper" way to do pixel art which is based on working within limited parameters and consistent pixel size, limited color pallets. It's a very common thing I notice with ai generated pixel art. It does not consistently look right it looks hand drawn. So I'm curious how you made them. The characters are super cute! but use these poses for something else in game , and draw them again but fighting.

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body:
Like a really simple drawing so the ai knew how to position the volcano dungeon. 

For characters, each body part is drawn separately and then i’m using transform animation in Unity. Similarly as old Flash games were done. That way I achieved a huge variety of customization and animations stay the same regardless of body parts and weapon skins. Not the traditional way of doing pixel art! It was either that or making a million of frame by frame animations. AI did mesh together a few pixels when combining background with cropouts of characters and added a tail to the frog but alright.

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/nfkhp9yaps9h1.png?width=1836&format=png&auto=webp&s=be4806d20c07f52e7736f16790e3d422b8cfe7dd

That’s the screenshot from ingame. It almost did a perfect cropout. Gotta use fully green background and fighting poses next time.

comments.author: Fun_Score5537
comments.body:
Nah.

AI is great for a bunch of things, but I think that 2D art still looks soulless and lazy. If I see AI artwork on the store, I immediately hesitate.

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: I work in the opposite way. When I see obvious AI capsule art and if the title looks relatively interesting then I usually at least check the page out to see what they cooked up and if the game represents what capsule art shows.

comments.author: morfidon
comments.body: Top one is better but it's ai right? I don't think most ppl would notice

comments.author: Laughing_Bleach
comments.body:
I have no idea how people aren’t immediately realizing that the top one is AI.   
It clearly feels more animated and better, but my only question would be are there guns in your game? Otherwise the guy with the gun would seem really off.

replies.author: eRickoCS
replies.body: There will be guns yeah so that was intentional, weapons represent classes that have own set of abilities. Inspired by LoL but not a MOBA more like Arena Brawler/Battle-Royale and other gamemodes.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: That is what I call excellent observational skills!   I saw the gun but totally didn't think that was a question.  To be fair even in the game had no guns and no ducks it wouldn't bother me because I don't expect the box art or the promo art to actually be what the game looks like.
